name: node-agent-todo
description: The todo node: a Today card of free text with model-written buttons, plus a tickable list

node.desc: Today card with free text and model-written buttons, plus a tickable list

text.description: the free text on the Today card (may be empty)

buttons.description: up to 8 action buttons; each press sends its message to the agent

message.description: the user message a press sends, 1-500 characters

set-today.description: Write the free text on Today, and optionally its buttons; returns confirmation text

press.description: Send one Today button's message to the agent as a chat turn; returns a receipt

presses.description: Read the last presses this node sent: a rejected message is in here too

list.description: Read the list; returns todos (id, title, text, done, at, doneAt, order) - the open ones first, then the done ones, in the order a human put them (order) or the newest id first

add.description: Add one; returns confirmation text (with id and title)

update.description: Update the title or the notes by id; returns confirmation text

id.description: which todo to check or uncheck

done.description: true checks it off, false reopens it; left out it flips

toggle.description: Check a todo off or reopen it; returns confirmation text (with id and title)

remove.description: Remove by id; returns confirmation text (with id and title)

before.description: the id of the todo to sit in front of (one of before / after)

after.description: the id of the todo to sit behind (one of before / after)

move.description: Put a todo in front of or behind another one of its own group (open ones before done ones); returns confirmation text

ui.description: Today card with free text and model-written buttons, plus a tickable list
ui.icon:
